questions.question: It was only when I had finished my homework that I realized I had forgotten to turn off the stove. The kitchen was filled with smoke.
options: The fact that I had finished my homework was what caused me to forget to turn off the stove.
I forgot to turn off the stove because I had finished my homework.
It was only when I had finished my homework that I realized I had forgotten to turn off the stove, which is why the kitchen was filled with smoke.
Having finished my homework was the reason I forgot to turn off the stove.
questions.answer: I forgot to turn off the stove because I had finished my homework.

questions.question: Unless you had been there, you wouldn't understand why I decided not to attend the party.
options: You wouldn't have understood why I didn't go to the party unless you had been there.
If you hadn't been there, you would still have understood why I decided not to attend the party.
It's only because you were at the party that you understand why I didn't go.
Unless you'd been there, you wouldn't know why I chose not to attend.
questions.answer: You wouldn't have understood why I didn't go to the party unless you had been there.

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the airport, my flight had already departed.
options: My flight had left by the time I got to the airport.
I was late for my flight because it had departed by the time I arrived at the airport.
It was only when I reached the airport that I discovered my flight had taken off without me.
Arriving at the airport, I found out that my flight had already left.
questions.answer: My flight had left by the time I got to the airport.

questions.question: It is essential that all employees be aware of the company's new policies.
options: All staff must know about the new rules.
It is necessary for everyone in the company to understand the changes.
The employees should be informed about the new policies.
That all workers are made aware of the new policies is crucial.
questions.answer: It is essential that all employees be aware of the company's new policies.

questions.question: I wasn't surprised when I heard the news, but my grandmother was extremely upset.
options: My grandmother was shocked by the news, whereas I had expected it.
Although I wasn't surprised, my grandmother reacted with great distress.
It wasn't surprising that I wasn't affected emotionally by the news, given its nature.
While I remained calm, my grandmother's reaction to the news was one of intense sadness.
questions.answer: Although I wasn't surprised, my grandmother reacted with great distress.
